Easy difficulty configuration:
- Timer: 60 seconds per question
- Multiple Choice distractors: cross-chapter (easy to eliminate by topic)
- Fill-in-Blank grading: standard hybrid (keyword match for short cards, self-grade for long)
- Flashcard mode: untimed — always
- Purpose: gentle warm-up, builds familiarity with the content

Hard difficulty configuration:
- Timer: 24 seconds per question
- Multiple Choice distractors: hand-crafted plausible distractors (Option A/B) and negative questions (Option C)
- Fill-in-Blank grading: standard hybrid
- Flashcard mode: untimed — timer does not apply to MC and FIB only
- Timer expiry: marks card for review, reveals answer, auto-advances
- Purpose: maximum challenge, closest to real exam time pressure
